classifications.rationale: Agency heads must pursue contractor compliance through appropriate measures; this assigns enforcement responsibility and discretion without itself changing contractual rights or dictating a particular later sanction.
classifications.evidence: shall take appropriate measures to bring about the said compliance

classifications.rationale: Agency heads must establish procedures or take other appropriate measures to carry out an assigned internal responsibility, with no specified legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: shall take appropriate measures, including but not limited to the establishment of compliance procedures

classifications.rationale: The President immediately creates and prescribes the staffing of an executive committee, an internal organizational action expressly covered by Code 1.
classifications.evidence: There is hereby established the Government Contract Committee

classifications.rationale: The Committee must recommend improvements, while agencies must cooperate and provide information and assistance; these are internal advisory and coordination duties.
classifications.evidence: All contracting agencies of the Government are directed and authorized to cooperate with the Committee

classifications.rationale: The Committee is directed to adopt procedural rules for performing its own functions, an internal housekeeping authority rather than a rule imposing external legal consequences.
classifications.evidence: The Committee shall establish such rules as may be necessary for the performance of its functions

classifications.rationale: The Committee must report, may receive complaints, and must route received complaints for agency processing; these are administrative reporting and workflow functions.
classifications.evidence: Complaints received shall be transmitted by the Committee to the appropriate contracting agencies

classifications.rationale: Contracting agencies must report their complaint-handling actions to the Committee, creating an internal reporting duty with no direct legal consequence for complainants or contractors.
classifications.evidence: Each contracting agency shall report to the Committee the action taken

classifications.rationale: The Committee must review agency reports and encourage nongovernmental educational activity, which are analytical and hortatory implementation functions rather than legally consequential acts.
classifications.evidence: The Committee shall review and analyze the reports submitted to it

classifications.rationale: The Committee may form cooperative relationships, and named agencies must support its authorized operating expenses subject to an internal allocation cap; these concern coordination and executive administration.
classifications.evidence: no agency shall supply more than 50% of the funds necessary to carry out the purposes of this order

classifications.rationale: The Labor and Justice Departments receive specified internal support assignments for the Committee, involving facilities and legal services rather than external legal rights.
classifications.evidence: The Department of Labor shall provide necessary space and facilities for the Committee

classifications.rationale: The provision immediately revokes a prior order, abolishes its committee, transfers administrative assets, and assigns wind-up work; under the codebook, this executive reorganization is Code 1.
classifications.evidence: Executive Order No. 10308 of December 5, 1951 (16 P. R. 12303) is hereby revoked
